## 简体中文

### 修复

- 区分缺少定位权限与 Wi-Fi 接口未连接：未知状态显示问号和明确的定位权限提示，不再误报网络可用。

## English

### Fixed

- Distinguished missing Location permission from a disconnected Wi-Fi interface: an unknown-status question mark and an explicit location-access prompt are now shown instead of reporting the network as available.
